shared: Generate an ORIGINAL premium ecommerce demonstration image, not a screenshot or app interface. Two equal panels in a 16:9 canvas; LEFT is input, RIGHT is the result. Panels touch exactly at the vertical midpoint, absolutely no gutter or border. Each panel is 8:9. Keep every important subject fully inside its panel with breathing room. Use sophisticated bright neutral lighting, physically believable material textures, tasteful cream/sage/terracotta palette. Unless explicitly requested, no text, labels, arrows, watermark, logos, brand names, numbers or UI. Preserve the exact object identity and geometry between panels, only change what the specified tool changes. The two panels will be separated into individual site demo images.

pairs.title: 高清修复
pairs.prompt: LEFT: slightly blurry low-resolution photograph of an ivory compact espresso machine with walnut portafilter handle on a pale kitchen counter. RIGHT: the exact same machine and identical framing, now crisply resolved with fine metal and stone textures. Only clarity changes.

pairs.title: 主体抠图

RIGHT: the identical chair perfectly isolated with GENUINE fully transparent alpha everywhere outside the chair silhouette, its outline and shape completely preserved. Whole chair and all legs fully visible. IMPORTANT: no floor, no carpet, no ground plane, no white oval patch, no cast shadow, no checkerboard drawn in the image, and no backdrop whatsoever on the right. Only chair pixels remain opaque. Left living-room photograph stays fully opaque.

pairs.prompt: LEFT: realistic still-life photograph of an orange ceramic vase holding three white flowers on a pale table by a window. RIGHT: exactly the same vase, flowers and composition transformed into refined textured watercolor illustration, with visible paper grain and elegant soft washes.

RIGHT: the identical shirt as a photorealistic upright hollow ghost-mannequin garment, with realistic chest volume and sleeves, no body, no visible mannequin. Identical buttons, collar and color.

gallery.prompt: Create one ORIGINAL 16:9 triptych with three equal vertical 16:27 panels directly touching, no gutter.
